tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Page ground. The grey the whole product sits on: site body, app canvas, docs background.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, sidebars, table bodies, inputs. One step above bg-app.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs. In dark it is one step lighter than bg-surface; in light it is separated by shadow-popover.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells below the ground: code blocks, table headers, histogram track, inline code.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash for rows, list items and ghost buttons. Translucent so it works on bg-app, bg-surface and bg-sunken.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected log row, active nav item, picked field. Carries fg-default or accent-fg text.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse chips and the marketing footer band. Text on it is fg-inverse.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and sections. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Edges of cards, panels, code blocks and tables.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on bg-app and bg-surface in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-default
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-sunken and bg-selected.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, code comments. Holds 4.5:1 on bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised and bg-sunken.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, decorative glyphs and axis ticks only (3:1). Never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: fg-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand fill: primary button, active toggle, progress, the run button. At most one accent fill per view. On dark grounds it is the loud lime, used the way ClickHouse and DuckDB use yellow.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover. Dark text in the dark theme, where the fill is light moss.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Moss as text: links, active tab label, keyword in running text. On bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-sunken, accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-fg: badges, highlighted search matches, callouts.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around accent-subtle areas. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every bg token in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, on the bg tokens and success-subtle. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons, on the bg tokens and warning-subtle. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, on the bg tokens and danger-subtle. Vermilion against bluish moss, so it survives red-green colour blindness; still always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button. Text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and hints, on the bg tokens and info-subtle.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind info.

tokens.name: level-trace
tokens.usage: TRACE label in log rows and CLI output. All level colours are text on bg-app, bg-surface and bg-sunken; the level word is always printed.

tokens.name: level-debug
tokens.usage: DEBUG label.

tokens.name: level-info
tokens.usage: INFO label.

tokens.name: level-warn
tokens.usage: WARN label.

tokens.name: level-error
tokens.usage: ERROR label.

tokens.name: level-fatal
tokens.usage: FATAL label.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: LynxFlow stage names and the pipe: from, where, stats, extend, sort, by, as. On bg-sunken and bg-surface.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Function and aggregate names: count(), p95(), top_k().

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: String literals and time ranges such as "timeout" and [-1h].

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numeric literals and durations.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments. Fields, operators and punctuation stay fg-default.

tokens.name: viz-neutral
tokens.usage: Default chart series: an ungrouped histogram is grey. Colour enters a chart only when it encodes a group.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: First grouped series. Series 1 to 5 are close in lightness, so every chart also carries a legend or direct labels and a fixed stacking order.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Second series.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Third series.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series. Past five groups, fold the rest into viz-neutral as "other".

styles.usage: Default reading size: docs prose, marketing copy.
styles.sample: LynxDB is a single-binary log analytics database.

styles.name: body-sm

styles.sample: Ingest logs once, query indexed columnar storage repeatedly.

styles.sample: Zero config is required for pipe mode.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The interface voice: uppercase eyebrows, nav links, column headers, tab labels. Always uppercase; the only style that may scramble.

styles.usage: Code blocks, the query editor, terminal blocks, inline code.
styles.sample: from main[-1h] status>=500 | stats count() by uri

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Log rows and data tables. Tabular by nature; never below 12px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A single headline number in the app: hit count, p95, bytes scanned.
